title: Restricted Sample Count Bound
statement: For every $n\in\mathbb{N}$, every subset $P$ of the $n$ coordinates, and all $k,b\in\mathbb{N}$, set $q=\lfloor3k/4\rfloor$, $\ell=k-q$, and $T_0=1$, $T_{j+1}=1+2T_j$. Put $A=(q+1)36\cdot4^k\bigl(\lceil\log_2T_k\rceil+2(q+1)+5\bigr)+2^\ell\bigl(\ell+1+\lceil\log_2T_k\rceil+2(q+1)+5\bigr)$. The restricted sample count, at failure parameter $2^{-(b+1)}/T_k$, is at most $A(n+1)^{q+3}(b+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
